children.game_version: Pogo stick jumping game without collisions

seniors.seated_version: Seated vertical torso bounce in place
seniors.standing_version: Supported vertical bounce holding a stable bar
seniors.tempo_and_range: reduced tempo and minimal jump height

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: holding arms stiffly at the sides or flailing them
movement_profile.footwork: jumping straight up and down, jumping in any direction, or spinning in the air
movement_profile.formation_and_space: dancers remaining on the spot or moving around in a crowd / mosh pit
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: legs close together or kicking about, torso stiff or thrashing
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: vertical jumps, occasional horizontal leaps and spins
movement_profile.partnering: individual movement, brief and energetic body contact with others

signature_moves.description: Jumping straight up and down on the spot with a stiff torso and rigid arms.
signature_moves.name: Up-and-down

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: potentially dangerous behavior, though accidental bruises and split lips occur; helping fallen dancers is mandatory.

reference_recordings.artist: Patricio Rey y sus Redonditos de Ricota
reference_recordings.title: Ji ji ji

music_profile.sound_description: Fast, aggressive punk rock music designed to counter the uniform disco beat, featuring driving drums and electric guitars.

basic_steps: Jump straight up and down on the spot
Keep torso stiff and legs close together
Hold arms rigidly at your sides
Optionally thrash torso or flail arms
teaching.formation: crowd gathered near or in front of a stage (mosh pit)
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with vertical jumping on the spot with rigid posture.
